localNetwork.decision: Aura does not request ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK and does not use local discovery APIs in current flows.

contacts.decision: Aura uses Android's contact picker selection plus just-in-time WRITE_CONTACTS for ringtone updates; broad READ_CONTACTS remains forbidden.

reflection.decision: Reflection is allowed only for reviewed platform/backward-compatibility bridges until compileSdk 37 removes the need for direct API bridges.

reviewedOccurrences.reason: Reads youtubedl-android FFmpeg binary and LD_LIBRARY_PATH values for local audio trimming.
Reads youtubedl-android FFmpeg binary and LD_LIBRARY_PATH values for local video crop/export.
Bridges Android 17 Photo Picker 9:16 customization before compileSdk 37 is installed.
Supports ML Kit subject segmentation beta API shape differences without broad reflection.

networkSecurity.decision: Release builds keep cleartext disabled globally; the previous ccMixter cleartext exception is removed.

dynamicCodeLoading.decision: Aura app code does not load native or dex code dynamically outside packaged dependencies.

tlsPlatformReview.certificateTransparency: No custom trust manager or pinned certificate override is used; Aura relies on platform trust behavior and reviewed HTTPS endpoints.
tlsPlatformReview.encryptedClientHello: Provider compatibility remains on platform and provider TLS support; no app-level ECH override is used.
